newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK gold closes easier, extending New York losses.
newsitem.headline: HK gold closes easier, extending New York losses.

text.p: Gold closed easier on Wednesday in quiet trading, extending the decline that set in overnight in New York.
Bullion ended at US$343.30/80 an ounce, down from New York's $344.00/50 close on Tuesday and Hong Kong's previous close of $345.30/80.
Dealers said they saw gold testing lower in the next few days.
"The stronger U.S. dollar prompted arbitrage gold selling," said a dealer at a major bank.
"The tone is a bit soft but there's a lack of trading interest with most local traders staying away ahead of the Chinese New Year holiday in Hong Kong."
The local tael market was closed for the holiday and will reopen on February 10.
